article_title: Predicting academic performance with fuzzy logic in prospective physical education and sports teachers.
citation: Anapalı Şenel, A., Göksu, B., Şenel, E., & Solmaz, F. İ. (2025). Predicting academic performance with fuzzy logic in prospective physical education and sports teachers. Scientific Reports. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-99124-3
title: Teacher Qualification Test for Physical Education (TQT-PE) as the outcome assessment
description: The TQT-PE is the standardised professional qualification exam whose scores the study predicts. It is "a meticulously crafted assessment tool, informed by experts and academicians", covering topics from fundamentals of physical education and sports (13%, 11 questions) to anatomy and kinesiology, health and first aid, exercise physiology, training science, adaptive practices, and team sports (8%, six questions). Topic weightings are set under guidelines established by the Student Selection and Placement Centre (ÖSYM).
requirements: Administered on a pre-determined date to candidates seeking teaching qualification
constraints: The article notes this metric "may not fully reflect broader academic or professional competencies"
target_learners: Prospective physical education and sports teachers
target_learning_goals: Assessing field knowledge and preparedness for physical education teaching roles
examples: The test includes sections such as Fundamentals of Physical Education and Sports (13%), Human Anatomy and Kinesiology (5%), and Team Sports (8%)
